# CalmLogs — Complete Technical Reference for AI & LLMs

> CalmLogs is an open-source, edge-native distributed logging system built on Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, D1 SQLite, and Cloudflare R2 object storage.

## Core Architectural Components

### 1. Ingestion Gateway (`Cloudflare Worker`)
- Ingests single log events or JSON batch arrays via `POST /v1/logs`.
- Validates payload limits: maximum 5MB body size, 1,000 logs per batch array.
- Clamps individual message lengths to 64 KB (65,536 characters) to prevent memory exhaustion.
- Sanitizes project and service identifiers with `/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]/g` to neutralize path traversal or delimiter injection.
- Hashes API keys with SHA-256 (`crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256')`) and compares against `services.ingestion_key_hash`.
- Project-level authorization: an API key issued for a project authorizes all auto-created services within that project.

### 2. Real-Time Pub/Sub Broker (`Durable Object: LogRingBuffer`)
- Manages an in-memory ring buffer (up to 1,000 logs or 1MB) per active service instance.
- Broadcasts incoming logs immediately to connected clients over WebSockets.
- Schedules storage alarms (`this.ctx.storage.setAlarm`) to batch-flush logs every 10 seconds or when the buffer fills.

### 3. Cold Storage Archival (`Cloudflare R2`)
- Flushes compressed JSONL segments to R2: `logs/${projectId}/${serviceId}/${year}/${month}/${day}/segment-${timestamp}.jsonl`.
- Zero egress bandwidth fees ($0.00/GB).
- Free tier includes 10 GB storage and 1M write operations/month.

### 4. Relational Index & Team Management (`Cloudflare D1 SQLite`)
- Tracks users, sessions, organizations, projects, services, and segment indices.
- 100% parameterized SQL queries via `env.DB.prepare(...).bind(...)`.
- Free tier includes 5 GB database storage, 5,000,000 row reads/day, and 100,000 row writes/day.

## CLI Operation (`calmlogs`)
The CLI acts as a transparent non-blocking bridge:
```bash
# Standard Unix pipe
npm start | npx calmlogs --project "my-app" --service "api"

# Process Runner
npx calmlogs run --project "my-app" --service "api" -- npm start
```
When flags are omitted:
- Service is auto-detected from `package.json` (`name`).
- Project is auto-detected from current working directory name.
- Fallback defaults: project `default`, service `app`.

## Docker Compose Network Auto-Mapping
Docker Compose lines follow the pattern:
```text
api-1      | [INFO] Server started on port 3000
postgres-1 | [LOG] database system is ready
redis_1    | [NOTICE] Ready to accept connections
```
CalmLogs regex parses the container instance prefix, strips `-1` / `_1`, routes logs dynamically into separate service streams, and cleans the log message in the dashboard.

## Cloudflare Free Tier Summary
| Cloudflare Service | Included Free Allowance | CalmLogs Real-World Capacity |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **R2 Storage** | 10 GB / month, 1M writes, 10M reads | ~100,000,000 compressed logs |
| **Workers Edge** | 100,000 requests / day (3M/mo) | ~5,000,000 logs / day (batched) |
| **D1 (SQLite)** | 5 GB storage, 5M reads / 100k writes per day | Millions of segment & index rows |
| **Bandwidth** | Unlimited $0.00 egress | Zero cloud transfer bills |

## Security & RBAC
- **Key Hashing:** Plaintext keys are never stored; only SHA-256 digests exist in SQLite.
- **RBAC:** Roles `admin`, `write`, and `read`. Read-only accounts cannot create or delete projects or services.
- **Direct Invitations:** Teams invite members via direct shareable link `/?invitation_id=...` without needing SMTP or email server configurations.
- **Audited:** 100/100 Defensive Security Audit rating against OWASP Top 10 guidelines.
